n = int(input())
b = int(input())
a = list(map(int, input().split()))
c = [1 if x % 2 == 0 else -1 for x in a]

sum_ = 0
differences = []

for i in range(n - 1):
    sum_ += c[i]
    if sum_ == 0:
        differences.append(abs(a[i] - a[i + 1]))

differences.sort()

total_cost = 0
count = 0
for diff in differences:
    total_cost += diff
    if total_cost <= b:
        count += 1
    else:
        break

print(count)
</translated_code>
